data.gender_notes: Karim is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ك-ر-م (k-r-m), 'to be generous, noble'. Karīm means 'generous, noble'. Its root is ك-ر-م (k-r-m). One of the 99 names of Allah (al-Karīm). Karim is a Arabic name meaning “Generous; noble; honourable”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Karim expresses “Generous; noble; honourable”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ك-ر-م (k-r-m), 'to be generous, noble'. Karīm means 'generous, noble'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Karim total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
